- **Date Raised:** 05 August 2024

- **GRN Reference:** GRN-2024-104
- **Supplier:** Meridian Glazing Systems
- **Discrepancy Type:** Damaged goods

**Description:**
Order for 24no. laminated glass units, 6mm + 6mm with PVB interlayer, size 1250mm x 2100mm, for the atrium roof. Delivery arrived on a stillage with each unit separated by cardboard interlayers. On unloading, two units were found to have a crack running diagonally across the full width of the pane, approximately 300mm from the top edge. The cracking was visible on the outer pane only; the inner pane and interlayer appeared intact. The stillage was wrapped in polythene sheeting and showed no signs of impact damage. The delivery note was signed as unchecked at the time of arrival, as the offloading team was under instruction to move the stillage straight to the storage rack.

**Action Taken:**
Photographs taken and sent to the supplier on 05 August 2024. The supplier's transport manager attended site on 07 August 2024 to inspect the units. It was agreed that the damage was consistent with the units having been stored flat prior to despatch, rather than on edge, which is against the manufacturer's handling instructions. documents.content:
**DR-2024-012**

- **Date Raised:** 05 August 2024
- **PO Reference:** PO-2024-0152
- **GRN Reference:** GRN-2024-104
- **Supplier:** Meridian Glazing Systems
- **Discrepancy Type:** Damaged goods
- **Status:** Closed

**Description:**
Order for 24no. laminated glass units, 6mm + 6mm with PVB interlayer, size 1250mm x 2100mm, for the atrium roof. Delivery arrived on a stillage with each unit separated by cardboard interlayers. On unloading, two units were found to have a crack running diagonally across the full width of the pane, approximately 300mm from the top edge. The cracking was visible on the outer pane only; the inner pane and interlayer appeared intact. The stillage was wrapped in polythene sheeting and showed no signs of impact damage. The delivery note was signed as unchecked at the time of arrival, as the offloading team was under instruction to move the stillage straight to the storage rack.

**Action Taken:**
Photographs taken and sent to the supplier on 05 August 2024. The supplier's transport manager attended site on 07 August 2024 to inspect the units. It was agreed that the damage was consistent with the units having been stored flat prior to despatch, rather than on edge, which is against the manufacturer's handling instructions. Replacement units were fabricated and delivered under DN-84512 on 19 August 2024. The two damaged units were collected for return on the same date.

**Closed Date:** 20 August 2024

---

**DR-2024-013**

- **Date Raised:** 22 August 2024
- **PO Reference:** PO-2024-0161
- **GRN Reference:** GRN-2024-112
- **Supplier:** Northgate Electrical Wholesale
- **Discrepancy Type:** Short delivery
- **Status:** Closed

**Description:**
Order for 150no. single-gang switched socket outlets, white moulded, to BS 1363-2, together with 150no. matching brushed steel faceplates. The delivery comprised 150no. socket outlets but only 120no. faceplates. The delivery note stated 150no. faceplates. The cartons were sealed and labelled individually, and the count was made at the point of storage. It is possible that the remaining 30no. faceplates were omitted at the picking stage, as the carton labels matched the delivery note quantities.

**Action Taken:**
Shortage notified to the supplier by email on 22 August 2024. The remaining 30no. faceplates were delivered under DN-84771 on 27 August 2024. No credit note was required.

**Closed Date:** 28 August 2024

**DR-2024-014**

- **Date Raised:** 09 September 2024
- **PO Reference:** PO-2024-0170
- **GRN Reference:** GRN-2024-121
- **Supplier:** Hadley & Rowe Structural Steel
- **Discrepancy Type:** Wrong item supplied
- **Status:** Closed

**Description:**
PO called for 12no. steel columns, section 254 x 254 x 89 UC, grade S355, length 4800mm, with base plates welded and drilled to the approved shop drawing. Delivery comprised 12no. columns of the correct section and length, but the base plates were supplied undrilled. The drilling was to be carried out at the fabricator's works prior to despatch. The error was identified when the columns were being positioned for the first fix, as the holding-down bolts could not be aligned.

**Action Taken:**
Site installation halted for the affected frame bay. The supplier arranged for a mobile drilling rig to attend site on 11 September 2024. The base plates were drilled to the approved drawing in situ. The delay was contained to two days and did not affect the overall programme.

**Closed Date:** 12 September 2024
